_what: The layers of artwork/happy-trails.ai, bottom of the stack first — the reverse of Illustrator's layer palette. A layer in the file but not in `order` is stacked on top and the build says so, because a layer you have just added should appear loudly rather than vanish. A layer in `skip` is left out on purpose.
_skip_why: The legend used to be artwork pasted into the map. It is a list of rows drawn from icons/ now, so the layer is still in the Illustrator file and no longer belongs in the map.
